title: Actions related to transmission of RRCReestablishmentRequest message

entities.name: RRC Re-establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for re-establishing RRC connection after failures

entities.name: RRCReestablishmentRequest
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate RRC connection re-establishment

entities.name: ue-Identity
entities.description: Contains C-RNTI, physCellId, and shortMAC-I for UE identification

entities.name: reestablishmentCause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for re-establishment (reconfigurationFailure, handoverFailure, otherFailure)

entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: Contains reestablishmentCellId for radio link failure reporting

entities.name: Radio link failure or reconfiguration with sync failure
entities.description: Condition when procedure is initiated due to radio link failure or reconfiguration with sync failure

entities.name: Reconfiguration failure
entities.description: Condition when re-establishment is initiated due to reconfiguration failure

entities.name: UE connected with L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Condition when UE is connected with a L2 U2N Relay UE via PC5-RRC connection

entities.name: Suspend integrity protection and ciphering for SRB1
entities.description: Configuration to suspend integrity protection and ciphering for SRB1 during re-establishment

entities.name: Apply default configurations for SL-RLC1 and PDCP
entities.description: Apply default configurations for SL-RLC1 and PDCP when connected via L2 U2N Relay

relations.description: RRC re-establishment procedure includes transmission of RRCReestablishmentRequest message
RRCReestablishmentRequest message contains ue-Identity information element
RRCReestablishmentRequest message contains reestablishmentCause information element
Radio link failure or sync failure condition guards the setting of reestablishmentCellId in VarRLF-Report
Reconfiguration failure condition guards the setting of reestablishmentCause to reconfigurationFailure
L2 U2N Relay connection condition establishes the need to apply default configurations
RRC re-establishment procedure establishes suspension of integrity protection and ciphering for SRB1
